title: Stock exhaustion
story: One product sells out and customers get 409 'insufficient stock'. The system is healthy. A good on-call engineer says so instead of paging the DB team.

report.root_cause: No technical fault found; occasional 4xx responses (such as InsufficientStock) or transient health fluctuations occurred while overall service operation remains normal.
report.suggested_fix: No action required; monitor the alarm to see if it clears or if it was triggered by expected business logic events.
